body:
Preview could finish setup but fail to start when Wrangler printed its `.dev.vars` or experimental-feature banners: the runtime tried to parse all planner stdout as JSON. The planner now streams its private result over fd 3, while its stdout remains visible on runtime stderr. Non-zero exits and empty or invalid results use the existing configuration failure message.

Adds a regression through `previewTarget` with a fake Wrangler and a real Miniflare listener, covering quiet output, both stdout banners, non-zero exit and empty output. Regenerates the vendored onboarding copies and CLI inventory, and adds an Unreleased changelog entry.

Validation: regression changes from 2 pass / 2 fail on main (banner: `Unexpected token 'U'`) to 4 pass / 0 fail. All 221 onboarding tests and all three existing preview journeys pass, along with reference typecheck and CLI copy verification. Full-history publication scan: COMPLETE PASS (1,526 commits, zero findings/warnings). Exact-SHA Verify [42508769042](https://github.com/runeditrun/base/actions/runs/42508769042) completed successfully for `ba5686bf8091b1425b01302b100908a89d3c3eda`. `[skip ci]` suppresses a duplicate PR-triggered run; this Verify was dispatched manually. Landing remains with the fleet lane.
